request.query: For f : α →₀ M and g : M → N with g 0 = 0 and g nonnegative, g (f a) ≤ f.sum (fun _ m ↦ g m)

items.name: Finsupp.sum
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_8} → {N : Type u_10} → [inst : Zero M] → [AddCommMonoid N] → (α →₀ M) → (α → M → N) → N

items.name: Finsupp.sum_fintype
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_2 : Fintype α]
  (f : α →₀ M) (g : α → M → N), (∀ (i : α), g i 0 = 0) → f.sum g = ∑ i, g i (f i)

items.name: Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ M) {s : Finset α},
  f.support ⊆ s → ∀ (g : α → M → N), (∀ i ∈ s, g i 0 = 0) → f.sum g = ∑ x ∈ s, g x (f x)

items.name: Finset.le_sum_of_subadditive
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N),
  f 0 ≤ 0 → (∀ (x y : M), f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)

items.name: Multiset.le_sum_of_subadditive_on_pred
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop),
  f 0 ≤ 0 →
    p 0 →
      (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) →
        (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → p (a + b)) →
          ∀ (s : Multiset α), (∀ (a : α), a ∈ s → p a) → f s.sum ≤ (Multiset.map f s).sum
